_about: Each legacyIdentityFixtures.ts case's plan figures as the planner produced them at 3fc751c3 (v1.192.0), the tree before v1.194.0 stored a PV surplus at the charge leg (legEff) in every walk: [chargeTonight, buyKwh, expectedBuyKwh, setpointSocPct, requiredExtraKwh, targetSocPct]. legacyIdentity.test.ts holds the planner to the direction of that change against them.
